# Dossier: Sample participant
## Aims
- [partial] Dense vs airy (confidence: medium) Loves Linear: "dense but still calm". Duels: s9 and s1 top, dense dark s15 last, airy s7 3rd. Leans dense-ish, not cramped. Why s15 lost is unknown.
- [partial] Playful vs serious (confidence: medium) "nothing shouts"; darker = "tool I'd trust with money"; colourful = "toy". "For fun apps, go wild": serious for work tools, playful only in fun apps.
- [partial] Notice first (confidence: medium) Sidebar first: "tells me where I am. If cramped I get lost fast." Not checked on a second numbered screen.
- [partial] Trustworthy vs cheap (confidence: medium) Cheap = "a gradient on everything and stock icons". Trust = "numbers line up and nothing jumps around". s6 least trusted, reason never given about the screen itself.
- [partial] Trade-offs (confidence: medium looks vs speed; low familiar vs fresh) "Fast over pretty every time for work stuff." Choice tool: "fresher, even if I have to relearn". Tension unresolved; three follow-ups bounced.

## Asked so far
- Linear must-ask (covered); screen-shouted question; s1/s2/s17 closest + eye first; darker screen eye first; s15/s6/s16 trust least (choice: s6); why s6 and first change on s6 (bounced / general answer); duels s1, s9, s15, s7, s6; s9 vs s15 Monday; work app after update (bounced); layout change choice; what must stay the same (bounced); sidebar on right (bounced).
- Offered stop/go on; participant chose to stop. Ended.

## What we know
- Loves Linear: fast, quiet, dense but calm (said)
- Big table = purposeful; huge graphs = hunting (said)
- Darker = serious = trustworthy; colourful = toy (said)
- Eye goes to sidebar first (said)
- Cheap = gradient on everything + stock icons; trust = aligned numbers, nothing jumping (said)
- Fast over pretty for work; fun apps can be wild (said)
- Least trusted of s15/s6/s16 = s6 (choice)
- Daily-use ranking: s9 > s1 > s7 > s6 > s15 (duels)
- Welcomes fresher look even if relearning (choice)

## How to talk to them
- Short, direct; open why/story questions bounced with "a bit of both" (several times). Forced choices and screens worked better.
- Style now: warmth 3, humour 2, length 2

## Findings
- Aim 1: moderately dense but calm, not cramped (medium). Evidence: Linear, duels s9/s1 top. Unsure why dense s15 ranked last.
- Aim 2: serious for daily work tools, playful acceptable only in fun apps (medium). Evidence: dark = trust, colourful = toy, "go wild" for fun apps.
- Aim 3: sidebar first, for orientation (medium). Not tested on a second screen.
- Aim 4: trust = aligned numbers, stability; cheap = gradients, stock icons (medium). s6 least trusted, reason unstated.
- Aim 5: speed over looks for work (medium); familiar vs fresh unsure (low). Chose "fresher even if relearn" but could not say what must stay constant.
